Week 13 / H3 / 2026-11-30 / Mechanism

Retrieval studio: diagnose and package failures

Complete eight core tasks, then preserve an honest failure.

One mechanism, one boundary, one observable check.

NCKU + LAiMM / Fall 2026 / H3: 60 minutes1 / 30
2 minutes / practice. Teaching intent: Build an evidence-first retrieval record. Define: Complete eight core tasks, then preserve an honest failure. Walk through: Restore 5 min; tasks 25 min; source audit 15 min; export and explain-back 15 min. Ask: What is the artifact, not just the score? Expected answer and boundary: A corpus snapshot, ranking configuration, per-query records, response fields, figures and hashes. Visual purpose: show Question > Ranked evidence > Support audit > Export. Facilitation: ask students for a prediction before execution, locate the actual intermediate values, and distinguish observation from interpretation. Transition: connect this checked mechanism to the next beat; preserve the lab artifact where requested. [Sources] https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11401 ; https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.feature_extraction.text.TfidfVectorizer.html. Task 2: explain one weighted term

NCKU + LAiMM / Fall 2026 / H3: 60 minutes7 / 30
2 minutes / practice. Teaching intent: Task 2: explain one weighted term. Define: Compare term frequency, document frequency and IDF contribution. Walk through: An IDF of 1.0 is not zero; the default smoothed formula retains corpus-common terms. Ask: What changes if the corpus changes? Expected answer and boundary: Vocabulary, document frequencies, IDF, norms and rankings may all change. Preserve an index version. Visual purpose: show Term count > Document frequency > IDF > Vector norm. Week 13 / H3 / 2026-11-30 / Mechanism

Task 3: compute macro retrieval recall

Calculate per-query recall before averaging answerable cases.

One mechanism, one boundary, one observable check.

NCKU + LAiMM / Fall 2026 / H3: 60 minutes10 / 30
2 minutes / practice. Teaching intent: Task 3: compute macro retrieval recall. Define: Calculate per-query recall before averaging answerable cases. Walk through: Two queries with one and two relevant documents each receive equal weight under macro averaging. Ask: Is macro recall the same as pooled recall? Expected answer and boundary: Not generally. Pooled recall weights by the number of relevant documents. Name the aggregation you use. Visual purpose: show Per-query intersection > Denominator > Recall > Macro mean. Facilitation: ask students for a prediction before execution, locate the actual intermediate values, and distinguish observation from interpretation. Transition: connect this checked mechanism to the next beat; preserve the lab artifact where requested. Task 4: find a citation failure

Compare a truthful quote with a wrong-threshold claim.

One mechanism, one boundary, one observable check.

NCKU + LAiMM / Fall 2026 / H3: 60 minutes13 / 30
2 minutes / practice. Teaching intent: Task 4: find a citation failure. Define: Compare a truthful quote with a wrong-threshold claim. Walk through: Do not say only 'bad citation'. Identify the changed number, missing unit or absent quote. Ask: Can an automatic pass replace source reading? Expected answer and boundary: No. The class checks exact fields and narrow numeric facts; general semantic support remains a separate review. Visual purpose: show Source exists > Quote exact > Numeric claim agrees? > Review. Facilitation: ask students for a prediction before execution, locate the actual intermediate values, and distinguish observation from interpretation. Transition: connect this checked mechanism to the next beat; preserve the lab artifact where requested.
